title: deskcrit measured differences across pages
description: The file that plugin/skills/design-critic/scripts/compare-facts.mjs writes (docs/PRD.md FR-84): the differences across the facts files (FR-79) of the pages of one set, for the set critic and the picker. Written for JSON Schema draft 2020-12; the $schema keyword is left out by project rule, so a validator must be set to draft 2020-12. A value that every page shares is not listed. Pages are numbered from 1 in the order given, like the tiles of the contact sheet.

viewport.description: The viewport compared: a viewport name of the facts files (FR-85), w<N> for a width given with --width, and a name that ends in -dark for a dark entry (--dark). The -dark names were added 2026-11-24 (crit-jb2).

file.description: The facts file path as given.

pages.description: One entry per page, in page order. A value of null means the page has no such value.

selector.description: The selector of a text block that shows the value, or null.

box.description: [x, y, width, height] of that block in px of the viewport's full-page screenshot, or null.
